title: Pest Control Service Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Commercial Pest-Control Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Pest Control Service Inspection Checklist covers monitored pest activity, device network, treatment area, and contributing condition. The site pest-management coordinator records Commercial Pest-Control Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Pest Control Service Inspection Checklist keeps Commercial Pest-Control Service exceptions visible until the site pest-management coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pest Control Service Inspection Checklist at food, storage, waste, exterior, utility, and occupied monitoring zones. Document monitored pest activity, device network, treatment area, and contributing condition identity before Commercial Pest-Control Service begins. Compare monitored pest activity, device network, treatment area, and contributing condition findings with stated Commercial Pest-Control Service criteria; route unresolved Commercial Pest-Control Service issues to licensed or otherwise qualified pest-control reviewer. For Pest Control Service Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Commercial Pest-Control Service. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified pest-control reviewer to review Commercial Pest-Control Service conditions beyond the site pest-management coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Commercial Pest-Control Service, identify responsible parties, food, storage, waste, exterior, utility, and occupied monitoring zones, and the linked monitored pest activity, device network, treatment area, and contributing condition source.

fields.label: Device map, device numbers, and prior trend reference

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Commercial Pest-Control Service facts for monitored pest activity, device network, treatment area, and contributing condition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Commercial Pest-Control Service inspection checks
items: Activity type, count, direction, and freshness
Device condition, placement, and service result
Entry point, moisture, food, waste, and harborage condition
Treatment material, location, amount, and restriction
Trend compared with prior service thresholds

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Commercial Pest-Control Service evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Site Pest-Management Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Activity requiring different identification or method
Food-contact or occupied-area restriction not controlled
Structural or sanitation cause remains unassigned
Photographs of evidence and contributing conditions
blocks.guidance: Pause Commercial Pest-Control Service when treatment exposure, target identification, occupied-area restriction, or required corrective action is unresolved. Retain the available Commercial Pest-Control Service proof and route unresolved monitored pest activity, device network, treatment area, and contributing condition scope to site pest-management coordinator.
